Results.ReviewText: Nothing will ever cook as good as a weber kettle.  Grill, BBQ, and smoke all on this.
Results.Title: Always will be the Goat

Results.ReviewText: I upgraded my grill this year to the classic Weber kettle grill and I couldn’t be happier with it.
Results.Title: Best present ever from my daughter.

Results.ReviewText: Love the quality of Weber…..we have loved, bought and used Weber kettles for at least 30 years. Excellent value, exceptional quality, the best grilling experience you could want. When we get a new kettle, we pass our old one to a new user…..
Results.Title: Not my first Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I had a situation that needed customer service attention. They were quick to help and my Weber experience has been more than a 5 star rating. They went above and beyond to make sure I had a product that I can enjoy years to come …..
Results.Title: Overall amazing customer service

Results.ReviewText: Can regulate temp my self,can also cook with indirect heat or sear without any electronics malfunctioning to mess up my meat,  I like being involved in my cooking. Got rid of a pellet smoker and grill went back to weber,thank you weber.
Results.Title: Great grilling

Results.ReviewText: Very happy i made my purchase! Ive always been a charcoal guy and i learned from my dad longago that the Weber Kettle is the waynto go! Its been awhile since ive owned one due but no regrets! Nothing beats the smell of the briquettes and an open flame!
Results.Title: The best!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, solid construction and very friendly, awesome purchase.
Results.Title: Back to charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: All ok except for the chip off paint on top cover.   Must have been during manufacturing because the packaging was quite substantial.
Results.Title: Chipped out paint on top cover

Photos.Caption: Rib-Eye, going on the ol' Weber.
Finished Try-Tip, slow roasted with the rotisserie.

Results.ReviewText: When charcoal is your best friend... you go with Weber.
Results.Title: Why a Weber?

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber gas grills for as long as I can remember, but this is my first kettle. Very short learning curve, and this is a very forgiving grill. Everything I have cooked so far has been amazing. Cooking the food is almost as much fun as eating it. Almost!
Results.Title: Amazing grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill for the money. No hastle with changing out coal debris after every grilling session. Just change it out when the hopper is full. Great heat distribution and couples great with a custom made grill table.
Results.Title: Best Grill for the money

Results.ReviewText: Second Weber I’ve owned and it never lets me down! I Barbeque on a weekly to daily basis and my grill is champ! Best daily grind grill 🔥
Results.Title: Best Workhorse Grill to have!

Results.ReviewText: Good quality and heavy duty materials that cooks great with super air flow. Assembly instructions are terrible tho. It wouldn’t take much to give a little bit of explanation on the assembly procedure. You have to figure out what they’re talking about from small drawings that are not fully recognizable. Apple succeeded with this idea of no instructions but I’m afraid Weber failed.
Results.Title: Great grill good quality/ air flow poor instructio

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with the height of the grill and the lid damper without a silicone grip. We will be sure to share this with our team for consideration. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill except legs are to short and no silicone grip for lid top ajuster
Results.Title: Weber charcoal premium

Results.ReviewText: As an apprentice griller, this Weber Grill is very helpful, comfortable and spacious. The quality of the materials is excellent and I know I will count on this grill for many years to come.
Results.Title: Happy with my weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I had a slight defect in my 22” kettle top that occurred after a few months of ownership. I called Weber and told them what was going on. They had me send a picture while on the phone and they reviewed it right then and decided to replace it. I had a brand new lid shipped to me within a few days!
Results.Title: Problem taken care of!

Results.ReviewText: As a long term user, I am pleased with the current purchase
Results.Title: Weber grill still the best

Results.ReviewText: Replacing my 30yr old Weber warhorse with this forest green sweetheart!  The old one has seen so many wonderful dinners I am looking forward to retiring with this one and the ash catcher is a huge upgrade.  I do wish the my had kept 2 handles on the lower half for loading into the truck but I'll get by.  Assembly was a breeze and the initial burn in and cook went excellent.  Looking forward to many more years with this one!
Results.Title: Traded my 30yr old for new for my own Xmas present

Results.ReviewText: Always like Weber grills.  Got the deluxe model because of the easy clean out feature and temp gauge.  Super nice!
Results.Title: Love our Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I just purchased a 22in. Weber grill. I have used it only once so far, we have had a lot of rain lately. I grilled some boneless pork chops which turned out pretty good. I’m very anxious to cook more foods on it such as chicken wings that are my favorite. I want to try some indirect cooking also. Once I cook some more I’ll give another review. Very happy so far!
Results.Title: First time using my Weber grill.

Results.ReviewText: Nothing says "Americana" quite like a cold beer, fireworks and smoke billowing out of a Weber kettle. Even in the age of pellet grills, kamados and offsets, the OG Weber kettle still holds strong in the world of grills. You can't beat the price point and quality of the product. Always keep one in my arsenal of grill options.
Results.Title: An American Icon

Results.ReviewText: We love the ease of use and flexibility with transport for our traditional charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Great for the deck

Results.ReviewText: I’m so happy with my new grill. It was easy to assemble and it’s easy to operate. It’s my first time using a charcoal grill (and I’ve not used a gas grill very many times, either). I’ve been able to control the grill temperature very well and I also find it easy to clean out the ash. I’m looking forward to many years of use.
Results.Title: Great grill (and I’m a newbie to charcoal)

Results.ReviewText: great product, it is actually 26 inches measured at the rim.
Results.Title: 26 inch grill, great unit

Results.ReviewText: Solid build- high quality construction, worth the extra money I paid!  It looks like it’s built to last.  I love the larger grill surface (previously had 18”).  Also love the lower venting labeling of degree of venting ie closed, partial, and full.  That lets me know when the vent is shut and saves on fuel.  Cheaper model required almost laying on the ground to see when vents were closed.  I like the lid thermometer so I know how hot the fire is.  Also love the lid hook to hang the lid on the side.  Paint job also appears to be of higher quality.  I expect this one will last 20+ years.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very good barbecue,  was absolutely taken back with the ease of cooking an the how the meat turns out.
Results.Title: Best charcoal BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Allows me to have control over my temperature and cooks perfectly
Results.Title: Great grill choice

Results.ReviewText: Great product great quality best punch for the price
Results.Title: Best quality

Results.ReviewText:
Love it!  Cooks perfectly and so versatile. This is my 5th Weber 
, but only my second full size kettle.  My other is my Dad's from 1990.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Cooks perfectly with so many options for searing, grilling and offset cooking. Very efficient on charcoal too. It’s perfectly designed and manufactured. I’ve been grilling for 40 years and trust me, you can’t beat the Weber Kettle. It’s the best!
Results.Title: Outstanding grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  Charcoal grilling flavor is way better than that from our gas grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: After owning two pellet grills and  several gas grills we went back to the Weber charcoal grill. Best decision we've made on a grill. You just can't best the flavor of a charcoal grill and this grill makes cooking ANYTHING easy and delicious!!  Will never buy any other again!!
Results.Title: Best grill on market!!

Results.ReviewText: This is a great charcoal BBQ.  I definitely would recommend this product.
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
Great brand. I had a problem with one of the parts and they send me a replacement kit two years after the purchase. Nothing is perfect but the most important what the company does to stand behind their products. 

I have a gas Weber BBQ also and charcoal one is my secondary bbq. Cooking with Weber charcoal bbq is a fun activity I look forward to. I also do a lot of smoking meat with it to and the end results are great.
Results.Title: Great grilling experience

Results.ReviewText: Thermomètre is defect, major différence between MEATER .
Results.Title: MEATER defect

Results.ReviewText: The Weber kettle is a great classic! Can’t ever go wrong with one, makes amazing bbq. Just a few things could make it better. Some sort of heat proof handle to change the vent on top and a better method for hanging the lid off to the side. Also the grate slots are to large for holding small pieces of lump charcoal and I loose a lot through the grates, but works perfect for briquets. Also the ash clean out doesn’t get all the ash out of the bottom of it but it works well enough to not be an issue. Overall it’s a great grill and worth the money and would purchase again.
Results.Title: Always a great purchase!

Results.ReviewText: Webber kettle grills are the best I’ve own 4 of  these grills 3 of the 22” and one of the the small ones I use 2 here at home when smoking briskets ribs or just grilling something quick for dinner like beef skirts or burgers I have 1 that I use at our ranch for doing the same especially for briskets the small Webber my son used while he was away for college being that he enjoys grilling as well for the price you can’t go wrong and they last for a very long time when properly taken care of.
Results.Title: Smoking Mesquite

Results.ReviewText: I can’t say enough of Weber products and their amazing customer service. I wished all the 6 I own were Weber brand.
Results.Title: Best customer service

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
